teaser.en: Before kerosene reached the coast, the oily seeds of this shady beach tree were pressed to light lamps.
teaser.sw: Kabla mafuta ya taa hayajafika pwani, mbegu zenye mafuta za mti huu wenye kivuli wa ufuoni zilikamuliwa ili kuwasha taa.

summary.en: *Mtondoro*, the Alexandrian laurel, is a spreading seaside tree with glossy leaves, fragrant white flowers and round fruits holding an oily seed. It is planted for shade on shores and in villages, and its oil and timber have long been used.
summary.sw: *Mtondoro*, au mtondoo kwa Kiswahili, ni mti wa pwani unaotanda wenye majani yanayong'aa, maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri na matunda ya mviringo yenye mbegu yenye mafuta. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli fukweni na vijijini, na mafuta yake na mbao zake zimetumika kwa muda mrefu.

about.en:
*Mtondoro* is a broad, spreading tree with a short, often leaning trunk and a dense, shady crown. Its leaves are thick, very glossy and oval, with fine parallel veins running across them from the midrib.

The flowers are white with a yellow centre and smell sweet. They are followed by round green fruits about the size of a golf ball, each holding a single large seed rich in oil.
about.sw:
*Mtondoro* ni mti mpana unaotanda, wenye shina fupi ambalo mara nyingi huinama na kilele kilichosongamana chenye kivuli. Majani yake ni manene, yanang'aa sana na ya umbo la yai, yenye mishipa myembamba inayoenda sambamba kutoka kwenye mshipa wa kati.

Maua ni meupe yenye kitovu cha manjano na harufu tamu. Hufuatwa na matunda ya kijani ya mviringo yenye ukubwa wa takriban mpira wa gofu, kila moja likiwa na mbegu moja kubwa yenye mafuta mengi.

where.en: It grows on sandy shores and in coastal villages, and is often planted. On the south coast, look for it along the backs of beaches and in villages near the shore, where its wide crown makes a cool place to sit.
where.sw: Huota kwenye fukwe za mchanga na katika vijiji vya pwani, na mara nyingi hupandwa. Katika pwani ya kusini, utaupata nyuma ya fukwe na katika vijiji vilivyo karibu na ufuo, ambapo kilele chake kipana hutoa mahali pa baridi pa kuketi.

uses.en:
The oil pressed from the seed has been used as lamp oil, in medicine and in cosmetics.

The tree is planted for shade, and its timber is used to build boats.
uses.sw:
Mafuta yanayokamuliwa kutoka kwenye mbegu yametumika kama mafuta ya taa, katika dawa na katika vipodozi.

Mti hupandwa kwa ajili ya kivuli, na mbao zake hutumika kujenga vyombo vya bahari.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtondoro*. In Swahili it is *mtondoo*. In English it is the Alexandrian laurel or beauty leaf, and its scientific name is *Calophyllum inophyllum*. Note that *mtondoo* is also the Digo name of a different plant, the snuff-box tree.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtondoro*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtondoo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *Alexandrian laurel* au *beauty leaf*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Calophyllum inophyllum*. Kumbuka kwamba *mtondoo* pia ni jina la Kidigo la mmea mwingine kabisa, *snuff-box tree*.
